resources.string: When diagnostics are on, keeps the first artwork video that fails processing (up to 20 MiB) and runs three background read checks. Wait about 15 seconds after reproducing, then export a ZIP containing the original video and results. Nothing is uploaded automatically.
No sample yet. Enable diagnostics and reproduce a video processing failure, or import a video.
A sample exists or checks are running. Export and clear the sample before importing another video.
Checks are still running; clearing is unavailable. You can export the original and current results.
Inspection sample cleared. Bindings and video cache are unchanged.
Video imported; checks are running. Export the inspection ZIP in about 15 seconds.
Import failed. Select a video no larger than 20 MiB.
Inspection ZIP saved. Send the ZIP file.
ZIP saved with the original and current results. Unfinished checks are marked in the reports.
